Related exam fact: transport allowance is not admissible at all to employees provided with a government vehicle. Notice how precisely the correct option is worded.

q: What is the rate of PF deduction from pay?
e: Option A — 1/12th or 8.33% of basic pay — is correct. The rate of PF (GPF) deduction from pay is one-twelfth, i.e. 8.33%, of basic pay. This is the standard subscription rate for the General Provident Fund applicable to railway servants. The Provident Fund is the retirement savings of the employee built through monthly subscriptions plus government interest.
